articles.summary: TOANO, Va., Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Board of Directors of CF Financial Corporation (NASDAQ:CFFI) (the Corporation) has declared a regular cash dividend of 50 cents per share, which is payable January 1, 2027 to shareholders of record on December 14, 2026. This dividend represents a 4 percent increase over the prior quarter’s dividend amount of 48 cents per share. The Corporation continually reviews the amount of cash dividends per share and the resulting dividend payout ratio in light of changes in economic conditions, current and future capital requirements, and expected future earnings. About CF CF Bank operates 32 banking offices and six commercial loan offices located throughout Virginia and offers full wealth management services through its subsidiary CF Wealth Management, Inc.
